result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks, marked crossings, or any form of pedestrian-vehicle separation. The wide, unmarked roadway and industrial land use suggest a priority for vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway alongside vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signals for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway safely.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use paint and bollards to define travel lanes and reduce the effective width of the roadway to slow traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, poorly maintained asphalt area that appears to serve as an industrial entrance or a dead-end street. While sidewalks exist on the periphery, they are discontinuous and lack formal crossing infrastructure, lighting, or safety features.

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left ends abruptly at a gated entrance, forcing pedestrians into the roadway to continue their journey.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The asphalt surface is cracked, patched, and uneven, creating significant tripping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would make the area extremely hazardous for pedestrians at night due to poor visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend and connect the sidewalks to provide a continuous, protected path for pedestrians that is separated from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility and security for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway and sidewalk areas to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure and narrow, obstructed sidewalks in an industrial setting. There are no marked crosswalks, signals, or curb ramps visible at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to navigate traffic without protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the intersection increase the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warnings to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with row housing, featuring basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and a curb ramp. However, safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and significant overgrown vegetation at the corner that likely obstructs sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Overgrown vegetation and weeds at the corner lot block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The grassy corner area in the foreground/center-left.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway surface in the foreground.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and weed growth through the sidewalk pavement create uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: The sidewalk area leading to the corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental-style markings to increase visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Clear the overgrown grass and bushes at the corner to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection, further improving visibility.
